rules.company_match: NFKC and whitespace removal, then complete-string equality; no aliases or parent/subsidiary substitution
rules.prior_history: Choice event year strictly less than the original M1 government cohort year; same-year ordering not classified
rules.explicit_rounds: Seed, angel, Pre-A, A/A+, B/Pre-B/B+, C and later lettered financing rounds; use the finalized separate Choice flags
rules.unmatched: Prior-history indicators remain missing for unmatched firms; no record does not establish no financing
rules.treatment_time: M1 uses the earliest observed municipal-fund year in the existing 2015–2024 government-fund export; the M1 exclusion of earlier observed other-scope funds is retained
rules.financing_vs_government_entry: First general financing and first government investment are distinct events. Earlier financing alone does not invalidate a first-government-entry cohort. Earlier investors need event-date fund/LP ownership evidence.
rules.no_private_imputation: All Choice government statuses remain unknown; neither match absence nor earlier timing establishes private VC status
